decision_rule_fixed_here: The arm words and their thresholds are fixed in scripts/analysis/slurp_nxt_r4_solver_decoding_column_read.py and in this package's README: NOMINATED, EFFICIENT-NO-LOSS, HARM, NEUTRAL against the in-flight twin aa (the A/A offset) and the decision-190 intent floor.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure; at most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id; run-cumulative budgets.

findings.finding: Owner rulings 329 A and 332 A open a DECODING-POLICY control axis at the Solver node. The R2b forced-close analysis found that the Solver's reasoning does not terminate on about 40 % of rows regardless of the budget (66 % of rows forced at 3,072 are still forced at 6,144), under greedy decoding at temperature 0; the candidate arms change only the sampling: d1-qwen-sampling {"temperature": 0.6, "top_k": 20, "top_p": 0.95}; d2-qwen-sampling-presence {"presence_penalty": 1.5, "temperature": 0.6, "top_k": 20, "top_p": 0.95}; d3-temp-0.3 {"temperature": 0.3, "top_k": 20, "top_p": 0.95}; d4-greedy-presence {"presence_penalty": 1.5, "temperature": 0}
findings.remedy: none; the read reports the forced-close share (split by supplied-item bin), the empty-gold false-fill rows (split by forced status) and each arm's discordance against the lock beside the twin's.

findings.finding: The per-node thinking fields are composed at request time, keyed by the contact's ROLE ID, and a decoding arm's override is applied AFTER them and only to the four sampling keys, so a Solver decoding-arm contact carries the same budget 3072 / max_tokens 4096 / enable_thinking / seed as the delivering contact. Proven at the request level by tests/unit/test_decoding_variants_live.py and tests/unit/test_nxt_r4_registration.py and, for the cell, by the dry run (node_decoding and decoding_override per arm).

The twin aa (replicate_of lock) is the in-flight A/A: its request is the lock's in every declared field, so its SLU delta against lock is the offset o of the read and its discordance share the run-to-run baseline of a greedy request at 4 slots (the R2b analysis measured 25 % forced-status flips between two greedy arms). The 268-B cross-flight offsets (SLU +1.15, P3.1 -0.61) are reported beside, never used in a word.

The request seed (20260913) is the lock's for every arm. A sampling arm at that seed is reproducible only up to the serving geometry's batching nondeterminism, so the arms are single draws, not expectations: the read reports each sampling arm's discordance against the lock beside the twin's and never reads a single arm as a distribution.
findings.remedy: none; the discordance table is in the read.

findings.finding: temperature, top_p, top_k and presence_penalty are in core.model.request_types.ALLOWED_DECODING_KEYS and core.model.transport moves every decoding_params key it does not own to the top level of the OpenAI-compatible request body, which is where llama.cpp's server reads each of them (read from source, no server was contacted). The llama.cpp build commit is the one the runtime receipt records; a build that ignored a field would show as a zero discordance of that arm against the lock beside a non-zero one for the other arms.
findings.remedy: the smoke reads the four-row per-arm decode cost; the read reports discordance per arm.

findings.finding: Arm d4 keeps temperature 0 and adds presence_penalty 1.5. Whether the pinned llama.cpp sampler chain applies the penalty before the greedy pick is a property of that build (read it from the runtime receipt); a build that applies it makes d4 differ from the lock, a build that does not makes d4 a second spelling of the lock and its discordance equal to the twin's.
findings.remedy: none needed to fly: the read reports d4's discordance against the twin's, which shows which case held.

findings.finding: The live slot is 24,576 tokens; the prompt limit of every contact at the 4,096-token cap is 17,406. Every arm renders the lock's template and evidence, so a decoding arm adds 0 prompt tokens over the lock's. The registered estimate (base 2,000 + the locked template 323 + 55 items x 235) is 15,248 tokens and the sealed Fold B Solver prompt maximum is 13,918 (the derive refuses otherwise). The context-fit policy is compact-or-abstain.
findings.remedy: none needed on the observed data.

findings.finding: The target is the resident think-budget-np4 session (serving-slurp-thinking-module-fold-b-np4-budget3072-max4096-v1, fragment q4km-thinking-mmproj-free-slurp-module-fold-b-np4-ctx24k-budget3072-max4096-v1); the fragment's defaults ARE the lock form, so there is no cell-level thinking policy and no serving change. The chain keeps the swap call, which is a no-op while that session is recorded resident and swaps to it otherwise (the predecessor chain may have flown another geometry).

A row costs one Perception contact plus 6 Solver contacts; every Solver contact is costed at the lock's measured Solver seconds (64.07 s), so the arm mix is 3.61 lock-row equivalents and the expected cost 33.3 GPU-h against the lock flight's 9.23 GPU-h. A sampling arm may reason for more or fewer tokens than the greedy lock (a sampling arm that does not loop stops earlier; one that wanders may run to the cap), so the cost is an estimate, not an envelope. Runs of 24 GPU-h or more are intended (owner).
findings.remedy: the smoke measures the real mix; the machine sign-off refuses unless it is within 1.3x of the registered one.

findings.finding: Ruling 303 A: one experiment in flight. This package is DRAFT / HELD until the predecessor chain named to the queue hook (the carrier base runs at the time of writing) has exited rc 0 (scripts/flights/batch/queue/queue_nxt4_after_chain.sh <exit-token> <chain-out> <start-stamp> waits for that line, then flips and starts the chain).
findings.remedy: the coordinator registers (derive .. commit) while the predecessor flies; the hook does flip .. chain.

findings.finding: As in the 268-B cells the model-free preflight counts the payload at 4 bytes per token (a placeholder); the cells defer to the registered exact per-contact context-fit gate (preflight_budget_mode defer-to-native-contact-fit), which runs on every arm's REAL request.

The chain waits for the smoke's sign-off with chain_lib.sh wait_or_machine_signoff (reader nxt_r4_read.sh smoke, the conditions file the derive emits INSIDE this package, marker /home/chao/nxt4-decode-signoff.marker, veto window 20 minutes). A refused machine sign-off falls back to waiting for a coordinator marker (12 h).
findings.remedy: the coordinator may veto by deleting the marker or creating /home/chao/batch-STOP during the window.

one_factor: the Solver's sampling parameters (temperature / top_p / top_k / presence_penalty at the lock's fixed seed); the system is the 268-B Thinking lock on TRAIN Fold B
prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or Fold A contact (TRAIN Fold B only).
No supply arm, no thinking column, no tool schema on any role; no Reviewer or Planner visit; max_revisions 0.

The system is the 268-B Thinking lock: the knowledge supply, the module graph, the post-processing, the Solver instruction template, the per-node thinking budget and cap, the request seed and the roster are not changed. The Solver's SAMPLING parameters (temperature, top_p, top_k, presence_penalty) are the ONLY varied factor.

Every Solver arm contact carries the lock's thinking fields (budget 3072, cap 4096) and the lock's request seed; no arm may set a seed, a cap, a response format, a thinking switch or a tool (refused by name at config load).
arm_visits is first: the fan-out happens at the one Solver visit; the delivering arm's request is the locked plan's request, byte for byte (invariant I7v), and so is the twin's.
No reasoning text is ever delivered, scored or carried to another node (reasoning_context_policy drop-reasoning-v1); a delivered reasoning marker stops the flight.
No benefit claim and no admission: claims_benefit is false; a NOMINATED or EFFICIENT-NO-LOSS arm goes to a 2-arm Fold A confirm (not built here).

No flight before the coordinator countersigns the DRAFT rows, mints the decision receipt, the harness commit is on master, the predecessor chain named to the queue hook has exited rc 0 and the cells are flipped.
No session is started by this registration. No paper-scale profile. No system-level claim.
the_question: Does a change of the Solver's sampling parameters move the score of the locked Thinking system (owner rulings 329 A and 332 A, the decoding-policy axis)? Each candidate arm and the twin aa are read PAIRED per row against the delivering lock arm on the same 1,080 Fold B rows in one flight.
